decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting serves a niche with long procurement cycles and rising defense demand, so its value is still uncertain and potentially large while keeping it costs little.
The spring-balanced desk lamp has its own page and costs little to keep, and one year is too short to judge its value in a competitive office lighting market.
The general interior luminaire is a second-generation update with its own page, which extends an established line with low uncertainty and low carrying cost.
The microprismatic pendant luminaire is only mentioned and its results are still unresolved, but keeping it in the portfolio is cheap, so the option stays open.
HMI technology is being displaced by LED, so this marine searchlight faces some abandonment risk, but marine customers need long-term supply and it overlaps with Product F.
The marine searchlight fits the firm's maritime niche and has low carrying cost, so it is kept while its uncertain prospects resolve.
